subject: SIG / SOC2: audit log custody & export options — sample extract plan
messages:
From: Audits Team <audits@clearline.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: admin activity logs for SIG/SOC2 review — scope & preferred formats

Hi Jasmine,

We're preparing the SIG/SOC2 evidence bundle for Acme Health and need a scoped export of Redwood's admin activity (operator) logs. To keep the handoff tight, can you confirm you can deliver the following items and a short sample by EOD two business days from now?

Requested deliverables (high level):
- Complete operator/admin action stream for tenant: acme-health (UTC timestamps) for the window 2027-02-01 -> 2027-02-28.
- Manifest with per-file SHA256 checksums and a top-level HMAC signature.
- Metadata: schema version, timezone normalization note, sequence numbers, and redaction notes if any PII removed.
- Preferred formats: Parquet (columnar) OR newline-delimited JSON (.ndjson). If neither is feasible, an encrypted tarball with CSV is acceptable.

Specific fields we will need (minimum): event_time, event_type, actor_principal, actor_role, target_resource, change_summary, request_id, request_path, session_id, correlation_id, and any attached metadata.

Transfer preferences: presigned S3 URLs preferred; SFTP with user/provisioning acceptable if we provide host details. Please also include an MA (manifest attest) and indicate KMS key used to encrypt the bundle.

We will sign the acceptance once the manifest & sample are received. If you have an internal runbook or export instruction doc, please attach a short sample (1–2k events).

Thanks — small ask but timeboxed.

— Audits Team
Audits / Compliance
Clearline Assurance

Attachment: none
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Audits Team <audits@clearline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity logs for SIG/SOC2 review — scope & preferred formats

Hi — thanks for the clear scope. We can deliver the requested export and a 1k-event sample within your SLA. High-level options we support (pick one):

1) Manifested S3 package (recommended):
   - Parquet files partitioned by day, compressed (snappy), with a JSON manifest containing per-file sha256 and a top-level HMAC.
   - Schema: admin_event_v2.3 (includes the fields you listed + model-serving operator tags).
   - Retention: full-fidelity operator events retained 90 days hot, 13 months archived; default retention policy noted in manifest.

2) Encrypted tarball (SFTP):
   - AES-256-GCM encrypted tar.gz, separate manifest.json (signed), delivered over SFTP.

3) Real-time snapshot (for small windows):
   - Streaming ndjson with checkpointed sequence numbers; useful for short investigative windows only.

Sample attached: admin_activity_sample.csv (first 200 events) — includes header row and representative event types.

Before we proceed, can you confirm the following so we package correctly:
- Preferred transport (presigned S3 vs SFTP)?
- Do you require redaction of IP address fields and username hashes, or can we provide the raw values under an encrypted export?
- Any special manifest signing requirements (we can sign with KMS key key-redwood-prod and provide attestation)?

Kimberly, Karthik — putting you on the thread for export mechanics (S3 buckets, HMAC).

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: admin_activity_sample.csv (CSV, 86KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Audits Team <audits@clearline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity logs for SIG/SOC2 review — scope & preferred formats

Thanks — technical notes from the export side:

- Event shape / schema: admin_event_v2.3. Key fields include event_time (RFC3339 UTC), event_type (enum), actor_principal (email|service), actor_role, target_resource (resource:id), request_id (uuid4), session_id, kv_changes (map), raw_payload_preview (truncated). We'll include schema.json in the manifest.

- Checksum & signing: we will provide per-file sha256 and a manifest HMAC. If Acme requests KMS-signed attestation we can generate a signed manifest using key-redwood-prod (AWS KMS). Please confirm whether you want the KMS signing certificate attached.

- Transport: presigned S3 PUT URLs are easiest for larger exports. We can also place a bundle in an internal S3 bucket and provide time-limited GET presigned URLs (recommended TTL 7 days). SFTP is supported but requires provisioning and will add ~1 business day.

- Redaction: by default we include username hashes and drop raw password fields. IP address fields are present but we can scrub them if required. Redaction decisions will be called out in manifest.redaction_notes.

- Performance/size estimate: uncompressed Parquet for 1 tenant (30 days) ~ 2.2GB; compressed ~ 600–800MB. Export time: 60–90 minutes to assemble and upload to S3 for a month of events.

- Timezone normalization: all timestamps normalized to UTC in export; manifest includes original tz offset for each event if available.

I'll attach the export instructions and a draft evidence_manifest_v1.json (stub with fields).

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer — Runtime & Exports
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v1.json (JSON, 4KB); export-instructions.txt (TXT, 2KB)
From: Audits Team <audits@clearline.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 14:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: admin activity logs for SIG/SOC2 review — scope & preferred formats

Jasmine / Karthik — thanks for the quick responses and the sample. We confirm the following:

- Transport: presigned S3 GET links (Redwood-provided). TTL 7 days acceptable.
- Format: Parquet preferred. If you must provide a compressed tarball, include the same manifest structure and checksums.
- Redaction: please keep IP addresses but hash usernames (sha256) and mark the redaction approach in manifest.redaction_notes.
- Manifest signing: KMS-signed manifest is required for our acceptance. Please include the KMS key ID and the attestation string in the manifest.

Timeline: we need the full bundle (2027-02-01 -> 2027-02-28) published with manifest by Friday 2027-03-12 18:00 PST. Please reply-to-all with the presigned GET URLs and the manifest HMAC when ready; we will acknowledge within 8 hours of receipt.

Acceptance form: https://rb.audits/accept/ACME-312 (use this link to notify us once links are up).

If any of the transport or signing steps require legal/contracting involvement, flag it now — otherwise we will expect the delivered manifest attestation and sign-off once we verify checksums.

Best,
Audits Team
Clearline Assurance

Attachment: screenshot-export-settings.png (PNG, 128KB)
